svg.title: Clay — Prompty CLI component theme
svg.desc: Throwaway visual prototype. Earthy terracotta and hands-on field labels. All 40 terminal components, with representative static states and a breathing row between selection titles and choices. Bracketed labels / warm cursor / compact answers.
svg.text: Earthy terracotta and hands-on field labels.
